feature_contract: 84 context features, captured before listing-semantics-v8 table-title projection. Frozen historical rows; rebuilding under newer feature code intentionally changes the rows.
annotation: Agent-reviewed primary listing scopes from saved public HTML before model output inspection. URL-level weak labels, not independent human gold. All anchors to a scoped URL share its label.
partition: Sources were assigned to train/validation/test before collection. Public source hosts do not overlap partitions. Synthetic legacy layout rows remain development evidence, not independent website tests.
acquisition: One listing per configured source through SafeFetcher, including verified redirects. No detail crawling, no access-control bypass. HTTP-rejected sites retained as unavailable. HTML is ignored local data, not redistributed.
limitations: Only eight linked inventories, with new training rows from two hosts; large ACL archive must not dominate by row count.
Primarily English/technical sources, with some translated Julia titles. No claim of broad multilingual generalization.
NumPy unlinked headings and CERN JavaScript listing were excluded from link labels; these are acquisition gaps.

Godot, Signal and Project Euler were not used for fitting or threshold selection. The later Project Euler preprocessing repair used its observed failure, so it is now a regression fixture rather than an untouched test.
No private account libraries, uploads, passwords, or user corrections were used for training.
